output.summary: A biennial or perennial flowering plant native to temperate Europe, it has fleshy, heart- or kidney-shaped leaves forming a basal rosette. Historically, it was consumed in drinks and sandwiches for scurvy, and its leaves were brewed into ale.
output.edibilityNote: Historically consumed in drinks and sandwiches for scurvy; its leaves were also brewed into scurvygrass ale.
